title: Smiling Boy Holding Frosted Birthday Cake, 1950s Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful young boy proudly presents a frosted layer birthday cake topped with slender candles, balancing the large serving platter outside in a grassy yard. He is dressed in typical mid-century boys' fashion with a short-sleeved open-collar shirt neatly tucked into high-waisted, belted trousers. Behind him, dense ivy covers the corner post of a white clapboard house, embodying the intimate simplicity of suburban domestic family milestones during post-World War II America.
